problem_description: Our village has contaminated groundwater and needs an affordable monitoring system to detect harmful substances.
Farmers are facing major crop losses because they cannot identify crop diseases at an early stage.
People in remote villages have difficulty accessing doctors and need a reliable system for basic healthcare consultation.
Our town does not have an effective waste segregation and collection system, resulting in garbage accumulation.
Villagers living near rivers do not receive flood warnings early enough to evacuate safely.
Many students in rural areas are dropping out of school because of financial difficulties and lack of educational support.
Several streets have non-functional streetlights, creating safety problems for pedestrians at night.
Young people in rural communities struggle to find suitable employment because they lack access to skill-development and job opportunities.
Increasing air pollution near industrial areas is affecting the quality of life, but there is no affordable local monitoring system.
Rapidly increasing traffic around major roads is causing congestion and delays during peak hours.
